title: 美国初请失业金人数197000 接近历史低位
speaker: Bloomberg

segments.en: Coming in there, 197,000 John, that's just more or less in line with expectations, and that number really leans into what we kind of already know.
segments.zh: 约翰，这个数字是19.7万，基本符合预期，也印证了我们已知的情况。

segments.en: The jobs market is in a good space. These initial jobless claims this morning, reinforcing the idea that we haven't seen broad
segments.zh: 就业市场状况良好。今早的初请失业金数据强化了一个观点：我们尚未看到广泛的

segments.en: base announcements of layoffs, for example, and we know that the official jobs at is also pointing towards robust employment and low unemployment at the moment.
segments.zh: 裁员公告，而且我们知道官方就业数据也指向目前就业强劲、失业率较低。

segments.en: Of course, Fed, policymakers, also expecting unemployment to remain low.
segments.zh: 当然，美联储决策者也预计失业率将保持在低位。

segments.en: When you see these initial jobless claims this morning, sometimes it's volatility in these numbers.
segments.zh: 看到今早这些初请失业金数据，有时这些数字会有波动。

segments.en: Not today, kind of reinforcing where we are, where the jobs market seems to be in an OK space for now.
segments.zh: 今天没有，这强化了我们的现状，就业市场目前似乎处于尚可的状态。

segments.en: Rarely volatility, and I might suggest, because every single week, and it just feels like it's 200K, 200K.
segments.zh: 波动很少，我可以说，因为每周都感觉是20万、20万。

segments.en: For a week moving average, 202, the number this morning, 197, the estimate, 200, the previous week, something like 198.
segments.zh: 四周移动平均是20.2万，今早的数字是19.7万，预期是20万，上周大约是19.8万。

segments.en: And we had this line from a Fed official in the last week. It was Neil Kashgari of the Minneapolis Fed.
segments.zh: 上周我们听到了一位美联储官员的言论，是明尼阿波利斯联储的尼尔·卡什卡利。

segments.en: He said inflation, quote, is in all aspects of the economy.
segments.zh: 他说通胀，引述，存在于经济的各个方面。

segments.en: And you starting to see it build in the labour market, because that would be a big development.
segments.zh: 你开始看到它在劳动力市场中积累，那将是一个重大发展。

segments.en: It's the missing piece of the jigsaw, John. We're not seeing it yet.
segments.zh: 这是拼图中缺失的一块，约翰。我们还没有看到。

segments.en: I mean, even though unemployment is low, as we just talked about, we're not seeing broad base wage pressure.
segments.zh: 我的意思是，尽管失业率很低，正如我们刚才谈到的，我们还没有看到广泛的工资压力。

segments.en: There are pockets of hiring pressure in the economy. We know that there are sectors where they complain they still can't get labour.
segments.zh: 经济中存在一些局部的招聘压力。我们知道有些行业抱怨仍然招不到劳动力。

segments.en: Some of that is linked to the AI boom boom. When you look at the aggregate data, we're not seeing broad-based wage pressure.
segments.zh: 其中一些与人工智能热潮有关。当你查看总体数据时，我们并没有看到广泛的工资压力。
